title: TokenBucket starves clients that poll frequently
statement:
Our API gateway uses ledgerlite.ratelimit.TokenBucket(rate=2, capacity=1). Once the initial token is used, a client that calls try_acquire() every 300 ms is never admitted again, even though the limiter is configured for 2 requests per second. A client that calls once per second works fine, which is why this slipped through review. available() and time_until() also report numbers that don't match the configured rate after short waits.

The class docstring describes the intended behaviour: tokens accrue continuously at `rate` per second of elapsed clock time, including fractions of a token, capped at `capacity`; a clock that goes backwards neither adds nor removes tokens. Please fix it without changing the public API (tests inject a fake clock).
targetSkill: time-based algorithms (rate limiting with an injected clock)
